freezing_rationale: Thresholds set BEFORE data collection; cannot be modified after. Any post-hoc relaxation = invalidates the run.
primary_test_statistic: per-phase Pearson r between aligned (clm_mind_tension @ 1Hz) and (eeg_alpha_PLV averaged over P3+P4+O1+O2 @ 1Hz windows)
permutation_null: 1000 random within-phase shuffles of EEG_PLV; two-tailed

criteria_all_required: consistent direction (same sign of r) across >= 3 of 6 phases
F-PASS_STRONG.interpretation: Strong evidence for real-time CLM <-> EEG coupling; mediator-framing H1/H2 testable in follow-up
F-PASS_STRONG.next_action: scale to N>=10 sessions for replication

criteria_all_required: consistency in >= 2 of 6 phases (especially P3 CLM-read showing larger |r| than P4 arithmetic control)
F-PASS_PARTIAL.interpretation: Weak but non-trivial evidence; coupling visible but underpowered with N=1

F-FAIL.interpretation: No coupling visible; consistent with N-1 v2 partial F-ARTIFACT and N-1 v1 BRIDGE_WEAK_REAL_HW; substrate-honest null
F-FAIL.next_action: bridge hypothesis falsified for current CLM v4 530M + W4 closed-loop config

criteria_diagnostic: random-control: shuffle phase labels (P1<->P4, P2<->P5, P3<->P6) and re-run analysis
if shuffled per-phase r distribution is statistically indistinguishable from observed (KS test p > 0.10) -> ARTIFACT confirmed
F-ARTIFACT.interpretation: Apparent coupling is degenerate or driven by within-phase autocorrelation; not phase-specific
F-ARTIFACT.next_action: investigate source of common autocorrelation (audio entrainment? line noise? clock sync drift?)

F-INDETERMINATE_default: if no tier matched (e.g. partial criteria met for STRONG but not all): reported as INDETERMINATE; replicate before classifying

phase_specific_predictions_pre_registere.P2_eyes_closed_berger: expected EEG alpha increase but null CLM coupling (CLM sees no user state)
phase_specific_predictions_pre_registere.P3_clm_read: ONLY phase where positive coupling theoretically possible (user attends to CLM stream)
phase_specific_predictions_pre_registere.P4_mental_arithmetic: matched cognitive-load CONTROL for P3; coupling here = artifact or shared cognitive-load mediator

key_diagnostic_contrast: P3_r vs P4_r: if |P3_r| > |P4_r| AND P3 passes threshold AND P4 doesn't -> evidence is CLM-specific not generic-cognitive-load
